title: Brik Provider Manifest v1
description: Declarative manifest describing a provider: one interchangeable implementation of a capability behind a testable contract. The tools list is the source the runner-image tool matrix derives from.

module.description: Module under lib/providers/ exposing the contract operations as providers.<module>.<op> (brik.use providers.<module>). Several providers of one capability may share a module when the implementing tool is the same (e.g. the three cosign-* providers share 'cosign'); the operative difference is driven by the referential, not the provider id.

endpoint_kind.description: Infrastructure-referential endpoint kind this provider operates against. Resolved by the binding (capability -> provider -> endpoint_kind -> endpoint).

binding.description: Which source binds this provider: the project (brik.yml), the environment (infrastructure referential) or the detected execution context (CI orchestrator).

contract.description: Contract id and version every provider of the capability must pass (shared spec set).
